summary: Desolace is the centaur homeland on the western coast, a grey bone-strewn waste under permanent storm — except that it is not entirely a waste any more. The Cataclysm brought water back to the middle of the zone and the Cenarion Circle has grown the Cenarion Wildlands there, green and treed, with Karnum's Glade at its heart. Around that the old zone continues: four centaur tribes at each other's throats, the Burning Blade dug in at Thunder Axe Fortress, demons at Mannoroc Coven, Hatefury satyrs in the ruins of Sargeron, naga pushing onto the northern shore, and Maraudon still open in the Valley of Spears.
history: This was Mashan'she, fertile grassland the tauren grazed, until their shaman spent decades trying to wake what they took for the Earth Mother beneath it and woke Princess Theradras instead. She drank the land dry to rebuild herself, and the dying was felt as far as the Emerald Dream. Cenarius's son Zaetar came to imprison her, fell in love with her instead, and fathered the centaur — who murdered him, drove the tauren out, and spent centuries at war with them. Much later Theradras drove her children into a killing frenzy to save them from the Horde; the Horde allied with Warug's Magram, went into Maraudon and killed her, and the Magram have led the united tribes uneasily since. Alexstrasza withdrew into this waste in grief after Wyrmrest, and Thrall came here to show her what Korialstrasz had really done.
factions: Kolkar, Magram, Gelkis and Maraudine centaur
